title: Concept: Conan requirement declared without a version
description: conanfile.txt declares a `requires` entry that names no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Conan resolves the reference to whatever the remote holds, so the compiled library version is decided by the remote.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.txt (conan).
risk: Conan resolves the reference to whatever the remote holds, so the compiled library version is decided by the remote.
